name: Irndorf (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Irndorf (two crossed white axes on black above green plants on white).
history: Municipal flag of Irndorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Irndorf arms — crossed axes and plants
